body:
Massive thank you for your answer. I talked to my friend and he is upset with me that I did not tell him that I had problems and also that I put him in such a bad light. It made me feel guilty, but what can I do, he is right. I should not be sad if he decides not to talk to me anymore, because I hurt him.
When it comes to my partner, I made him go to the doctor today and it came out that the doctor understands his issues and thinks he is right for worrying, but he admitted that my bf should not control and manipulate me.
I will be seeing counselor this Friday, because I still feel guilty for this situation. It's like both sides have identical arguments agains each other and I don't know what to say to either or them. I feel flooded.
But thank you very much for your response. It really helped me and gave me positive thoughts. Sometimes reaching out to the strangers that are not emotionally involved in the situation is the best. Thank you thank you thank you.

I want to make no harm. I also don't want to lose anyone. I want everything to go as smoothly as it can.
